notes:
### Product Overview
Otter.ai is an AI-powered meeting assistant and conversation intelligence platform that records, transcribes, and summarizes voice conversations (such as meetings, interviews, and lectures). 
* **Source:** https://withone.ai
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"Otter.ai is a meeting assistant platform that provides real-time transcription, recording, summaries, and searchable notes for voice conversations, allowing teams and developers to capture meeting content, automate follow-up workflows, and integrate conversation data into collaboration and productivity tools."`

---

### Public API Authentication & Multi-Tenant Usage
* **Authentication Methods:** The Public REST API strictly utilizes static personal tokens passed via the authorization header.
  * **Source:** https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/36130822688279-Otter-ai-Public-API
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"All API requests require authentication using Bearer token authentication... include your api key in the authorization header for every request: authorization: bearer your_api_key"`
* **Multi-Tenant Integration Platform Usage:** For a standard multi-tenant integration platform targeting the full REST API, the primary authentication method is **`bearer_token`** (manually generated API keys), as there are no public self-serve OAuth2 applications available for the REST API. However, if integrating via Otter's official remote MCP server, the primary method is **`oauth2`** utilizing Dynamic Client Registration.
  * **Source:** https://integrations.sh
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"The server supports OAuth Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591), so the client registers itself automatically — no developer-portal app, client_id , or client_secret to create."`

---

### Credential Acquisition & Cost
* **Public REST API (`partner_or_sales`):** Credentials are not self-serve. They require an Enterprise subscription and direct coordination with an account manager.
  * **Source:** https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/36130822688279-Otter-ai-Public-API
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"getting started: otter's public api is available for all enterprise workspaces. if you do not see this feature for your workspace, contact your otter account manager."`
  * **Source:** https://otter.ai/pricing
  * **Verbatim Quote:** Under Enterprise tier: `"otter api & webhooks"`
* **MCP Server (`self_serve_free`):** Access to the official remote MCP server is completely self-serve and available to all users at no cost, including those on the free tier.
  * **Source:** https://usecarly.com
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Otter MCP is available on every Otter plan, including free Basic. Connect it from Claude's Customize → Connectors with an OAuth login."`

---

### API Style, Breadth, OpenAPI Spec, Webhooks, & Sandbox
* **API Style:** REST API.
  * **Source:** https://integrations.sh
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Otter.ai exposes an authenticated Enterprise REST API at https://api.otter.ai/v1 using bearer API keys"`
* **API Breadth:** The API allows developers to programmatically retrieve workspace details, channels, conversations, transcripts, audio files, action items, outlines, and insights.
  * **Source:** https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/36130822688279-Otter-ai-Public-API
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"otter.ai’s public api provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details from your otter account."`
* **OpenAPI Spec:** No official public OpenAPI specification is provided by the vendor.
  * **Source:** https://apitracker.io
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"OpenAPI/Swagger specs. -"`
* **Webhooks:** Supported for real-time event notifications, recommended for export integrations.
  * **Source:** https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/36130822688279-Otter-ai-Public-API
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Webhooks are the recommended way to build export integrations with Otter. Instead of constantly polling the API to check for new conversations or action items, webhooks push real-time notifications to your application the moment events occur."`
* **Sandbox:** No sandbox or test environment is available.
  * **Source:** https://apitracker.io
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Sandbox environment. -"`

---

### Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers
* **MCP Status:** **`official`**
* **Official Server:** Otter hosts an official remote MCP server at `https://mcp.otter.ai/mcp` that connects user meeting data directly to AI models via OAuth.
  * **Source:** https://usecarly.com
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"backed by its official remote MCP server at https://mcp.otter.ai/mcp (launched March 13, 2026)."`
  * **Source:** https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/35287607569687-Otter-MCP-Server
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Connect AI models to Otter using Model Context Protocol (MCP)."`
* **Community Servers:** Third-party community implementations exist (such as `bcharleson/otter-cli`), but they are considered legacy and have been superseded by the official vendor-hosted server.
  * **Source:** https://github.com/bcharleson/otter-cli
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Agent-native CLI + MCP server for the Otter.ai API — 31 commands, dual-mode for humans and AI agents"`
  * **Source:** https://usecarly.com
  * **Verbatim Quote:** `"Pre-official community projects (DarrenZal/otter-mcp, bcharleson/otter-cli) still exist but are history now — the official server supersedes them."`

---

### Buildability Verdict & Main Blocker

Depending on the integration path Composio chooses to pursue, there are two distinct verdicts:

#### Path A: Full-Featured REST API Integration
* **Verdict:** **`needs_outreach`**
* **Access Category:** **`partner_or_sales`**
* **Main Blocker:** The full REST API and webhook capabilities are strictly gated behind the Enterprise plan and require manual provisioning by an Otter account manager.
* **Source:** https://help.otter.ai/hc/en-us/articles/36130822688279-Otter-ai-Public-API
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"getting started: otter's public api is available for all enterprise workspaces. if you do not see this feature for your workspace, contact your otter account manager."`

#### Path B: Official Remote MCP Server Proxying
* **Verdict:** **`ready_with_friction`**
* **Access Category:** **`self_serve_free`**
* **Main Blocker / Hurdle:** While a read-only toolkit can be built immediately by proxying Otter's official remote MCP server (which supports self-serve OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration on the free tier), the integration is heavily restricted to read-only search and retrieval capabilities. It cannot perform write actions or trigger workflows when a meeting ends.
* **Source:** https://usecarly.com
* **Verbatim Quote:** `"the connector is read-only, and like every Claude integration it only works inside a conversation you start — nothing fires when a meeting ends."`
